rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for music, voices, and other pleasant sounds.

example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 teng1

rows.note: Use this especially for a song, voice, or piece of music when stressing that it is pleasing to listen to.

example.english: Their voice is so melodious that any song sounds good.
example.traditional: 佢把聲咁動聽，唱乜歌都好聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baa2 seng1 gam3 dung6 ting1 coeng3 mat1 go1 dou1 hou2 teng1

rows.note: Use this more formal choice when describing a sound as pleasing specifically to the ear.

example.english: This piece is melodious and pleasing to the ear.
example.traditional: 呢段樂曲旋律優美，聲音悅耳。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 lok6 kuk1 syun4 leot6 jau1 mei5 seng1 jam1 jyut6 ji5
